# Apibara Vehicle Auction API Examples — Full AI Context

## Product

Apibara.tech provides a normalized JSON API for supported Copart and IAA / IAAI vehicle auction data. It is independent from those auction companies and separate from apibara.com.

## Canonical sources

- Product: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api
- Documentation: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/docs
- Endpoint reference: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/endpoints
- Canonical OpenAPI 3.1: https://apibara.tech/openapi/v1.json
- Compatibility OpenAPI alias: https://apibara.tech/openapi/vehicle-auction-data-api.json
- AI facts: https://apibara.tech/ai-facts.json
- RFC 9727 API catalog: https://apibara.tech/.well-known/api-catalog
- APIs.json: https://apibara.tech/apis.json
- MCP: https://apibara.tech/mcp
- Auction History API: https://apibara.tech/en/auction-history-api
- Incremental sync: https://apibara.tech/en/vehicle-auction-incremental-sync-api

## Public facts

- **20M+ lifetime/cumulative indexed auction records** across the lifetime of Apibara.tech. This is NOT the current retained dataset and is not a count of unique VINs or vehicles.
- **4,061,492 current supported vehicle/lot records (4.0M+)** in the production retained-data snapshot.
- **5,894,013 retained historical auction records**, bringing the current + historical retained total to **9,955,505 records (9.9M+)**.
- **Measured at:** 2026-10-27 11:30:02 UTC. These figures are a dated snapshot and will change as inventory refreshes. For current counts and source breakdown, use [live Coverage](https://apibara.tech/coverage.json) or [AI facts](https://apibara.tech/ai-facts.json).
- Approximately 30K+ auction records added or refreshed daily.
- Supported price and auction-status changes can refresh within up to 15 minutes and often sooner.
- Supported live-bid data can refresh in about 10–15 seconds when live source data is available.
- Free access includes 100 requests per month with no payment card required.

## Base URL and authentication

Base URL: https://apibara.tech/api/v1/vehicle-auction

```http
X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY
Accept: application/json
```

Keep API keys server-side.

## Endpoint map

- `GET /vehicles` — search/filter inventory.
- `GET /vehicles/{slugVin}` — retrieve one supported vehicle by VIN/lot/slug.
- `GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/history` — retained supported auction history.
- `GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/related` — related vehicles.
- `GET /vehicles/filters` — filter metadata.
- `GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/shipping` — vehicle shipping.
- `GET /locations` — auction locations.
- `GET /shipping/auction-to-port` — auction-to-port shipping.
- `GET /vehicles/urltodetails` — resolve a supported auction URL.
- `GET /usage` — authenticated usage.
- `GET /image-proxy` — supported image proxy workflow.

Use OpenAPI for the exact contract and current schemas.

## Synchronization

Use `updated_within_minutes=N` on `GET /vehicles` for recent-change synchronization.
Current public range: `1..525600`.

Recommended production pattern:
1. Initial cursor-paginated load for the scope you need.
2. Incremental polling with a small overlap.
3. Follow every `next_cursor`.
4. Idempotently upsert repeated records.
5. Advance a durable checkpoint only after the complete cursor chain succeeds.
6. Run a broader reconciliation window periodically.

## Search semantics

- Readable source: `platform=copart|iaai`
- Compatibility source: `auction_type`
- Upcoming: `upcoming=all|only|without`
- Auction mode: All / Timed / Buy Now
- Auction state: Open / Live / Ended
- Vehicle-search `per_page` is plan-dependent.

## History semantics

Auction history is retained auction-specific history, not complete ownership, accident, registration or government-title history. One VIN can have multiple Copart and IAAI appearances when available. An empty history response does not prove a vehicle has never appeared at auction.

## Agent execution

The canonical OpenAPI publishes provider-authored operation-level `x-agentic-access` metadata. The current data retrieval surface is read-only. The hosted MCP server is also read-only.

For facts that can change, prefer the canonical apibara.tech machine-readable resources over this repository snapshot.
